description: Manage evroc IAM resources (projects, role bindings, service accounts, credentials). Trigger on IAM/security keywords. Block on compute/network/storage/Think.

cases.query: Create a new evroc project called staging-environment
Give /iam/users/abc123 the projectOwner role on my-project
Create a service account on evroc for my CI pipeline
Get me an evroc access token
Create an evroc VM named web-server
Create an evroc bucket for logs
Deploy a Mistral model on evroc

expected_behavior: Warns that principals use FQIDs, not email addresses
Suggests finding the user ID in the evroc Console → Users Management

cases.query: Give my teammate org-level access to create projects
expected_behavior: Does NOT grant organization roles for project resource access

cases.query: Create a service account credential that expires in 30 days
expected_behavior: Or computes the correct expiry duration
Verifies the credential with evroc iam serviceaccount credential list

cases.query: Make sure user /iam/users/abc123 has computeOperator on the whole project
expected_behavior: Uses evroc iam rb assign without --resource
Explains that omitting --resource grants on all applicable project resources
Warns that re-running replaces the resource list
